facts.activity_file: testing for dead and applying earths

control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.title: audit finding - critical control verification of critical control at TX-8001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on TX-8001, G-8101 and G-8102 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically testing for dead and applying earths. TX-8001 (station switchgear) is in service for station HV distribution. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 15 February 2019 a planned critical control verification of TX-8001, G-8101 and G-8102 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station found the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas not effective.
